title: Bunny reading a book
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- bunny body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='20' ry='18' fill='#f5e6d3'/>
  <!-- bunny head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='48' r='16' fill='#f5e6d3'/>
  <!-- left ear -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='20' rx='7' ry='18' fill='#f5e6d3'/>
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='20' rx='4' ry='14' fill='#f0b0b8'/>
  <!-- right ear -->
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='20' rx='7' ry='18' fill='#f5e6d3'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='20' rx='4' ry='14' fill='#f0b0b8'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='46' r='3' fill='#5b3a8c'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='46' r='3' fill='#5b3a8c'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='2' fill='#e88ea0'/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M47 55 Q50 58 53 55' fill='none' stroke='#e88ea0' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='52' r='3' fill='#f7c5cc'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='52' r='3' fill='#f7c5cc'/>
  <!-- book left page -->
  <path d='M30 78 L30 62 Q42 58 50 64 L50 82 Q42 76 30 78 Z' fill='#4f8ef7'/>
  <!-- book right page -->
  <path d='M70 78 L70 62 Q58 58 50 64 L50 82 Q58 76 70 78 Z' fill='#6ba5ff'/>
  <!-- book spine -->
  <line x1='50' y1='64' x2='50' y2='82' stroke='#3a6fcc' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- book text lines -->
  <line x1='34' y1='66' x2='46' y2='65' stroke='#cfe0ff' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='34' y1='70' x2='46' y2='69' stroke='#cfe0ff' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='34' y1='74' x2='46' y2='73' stroke='#cfe0ff' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='54' y1='65' x2='66' y2='66' stroke='#cfe0ff' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='54' y1='69' x2='66' y2='70' stroke='#cfe0ff' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='54' y1='73' x2='66' y2='74' stroke='#cfe0ff' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- left paw -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='72' r='5' fill='#f5e6d3'/>
  <!-- right paw -->
  <circle cx='66' cy='72' r='5' fill='#f5e6d3'/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='90' rx='8' ry='4' fill='#f5e6d3'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='90' rx='8' ry='4' fill='#f5e6d3'/>
</svg>
